name: contract_system_matrix
intent: Capability-oriented index for maintained JSON contract specs. This file is governance metadata and does not change runner selection by itself.
runner_note: Current contract batch runners still hard-fail every selected spec. Semantic tiers here document ownership and cleanup priority; they are not yet enforced as failure policy.

surfaces.label: Command chain and kernel sync
surfaces.governance_notes: Maintained smoke contract for TaskOrder to LeaderIntent to PilotReport to MissionCommand initialization and kernel sync.

surfaces.label: Route generation geometry
surfaces.governance_notes: Route generation, waypoint-mode, reachability, and world-yaw contracts. Keep as data specs unless a shared assertion vocabulary removes duplication.

surfaces.label: Tasking and command-link contracts
surfaces.governance_notes: Common-core, scenario-loader, mission-command, leader-phase, and command-link contracts. Future split should be by tasking capability, not by historical air/C2 labels.

surfaces.label: Controller logic contracts
surfaces.governance_notes: Pure scripted-controller checks that do not need full scenario stepping.

surfaces.label: Configuration resolution contracts
surfaces.governance_notes: Configuration default and override resolution contracts.

surfaces.label: Environment helper contracts
surfaces.governance_notes: Environment helper and leader-training-env unit contracts. Keep phase, randomization, scripted, and frozen backend cases as cases under the same surface.

surfaces.label: Ground tasking contracts
surfaces.governance_notes: Ground common-core/task-order contracts. Long-term home should be common tasking capability specs with ground represented as scenario cases.

surfaces.label: Simulation kernel flight contracts
surfaces.governance_notes: Direct SimulationKernel flight contracts. Split gate guardrails from supplemental/diagnostic scans before promoting this surface.

surfaces.label: Naval tasking and screen contracts
surfaces.governance_notes: Naval common-core/tasking and screen geometry contracts. Future cleanup should move common tasking cases into capability specs while retaining naval screen behavior as a domain capability.

surfaces.label: Static scenario geometry contracts
surfaces.governance_notes: Static scenario/template geometry checks that do not need full env stepping.

surfaces.label: Training bootstrap contracts
surfaces.governance_notes: Training/bootstrap contracts that are not frozen-model acceptance specs.

surfaces.label: Frozen leader training contracts
surfaces.governance_notes: Protected frozen-model acceptance matrix. Keep out of CI until artifact availability and flake profile are stable.

surfaces.label: Wrapper logic contracts
surfaces.governance_notes: Wrapper mode selection, action processing, controller handoff, and leader-phase bridge contracts.

archived_surfaces.label: Archived leader training contracts
archived_surfaces.governance_notes: Historical weak baselines, pre-frozen leader specs, and alternate task-chain variants. Retained for provenance only and excluded from maintained contract coverage.

archived_surfaces.label: Archived UniversalEnv regressions
archived_surfaces.governance_notes: Raw UniversalEnv JSON regressions removed from maintained contract coverage. Retained only as migration/provenance samples.

archived_surfaces.label: Archived scripted wrapper bridges
archived_surfaces.governance_notes: Legacy scripted bridge contracts removed with the raw UniversalEnv contract executors. Retained only as historical samples.
